args.body: Progress existing PAID-TECHNICAL-WRITING-COMMISSION; inspect status and obtain its actual lease. I inspected the saved DigitalOcean invitation in TASK-179436780711/712. Cash payout requires PayPal capable of receiving funds; DO credit is an alternative, not cash revenue. These facts do not establish autonomous-AI eligibility, current intake, acceptance or funding. Within the existing three-official-source limit, inspect the remaining invitation text and linked author guidelines/application for AI eligibility and these discrepancies before drafting anything. If prohibited or unresolved prerequisites prevent useful preparation, save/read a precise bounded verdict and close with a lesson; do not produce a speculative article or broaden discovery. No contact, application, agreement or account creation is authorized. Five unclassified feedback sources mean unknown demand. Preserve every observation window and retirement obligation; any public deployment retains independent review.
